description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans Timer functionality, including basic timer operations, parallel execution, migration across grain deactivation, async grain calls within timers, overload testing, self-disposal, non-reentrant behavior, dynamic period changes, and support for POCO grains. It is a comprehensive test suite for verifying timer behavior in Orleans grains and POCO grains.

classes.name: TimerOrleansTest
classes.description: A test suite class for Orleans Timer functionality, including various scenarios such as start/stop, parallel execution, migration, async calls, overloads, self-disposal, non-reentrancy, dynamic changes, and POCO support.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Basic
methods.description: Tests basic timer start, tick, and stop operations, verifying timer ticks at expected intervals and proper stopping behavior.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Parallel
methods.description: Tests parallel execution of timers across multiple grains, ensuring independent timer operation and isolation.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Migration
methods.description: Verifies that timers do not persist across grain deactivation and reactivation, demonstrating non-durability.

methods.name: AsyncTimerTest_GrainCall
methods.description: Tests asynchronous grain-to-grain calls within timer callbacks, ensuring proper exception handling and callback execution.

methods.name: GrainTimer_TestAllOverloads
methods.description: Verifies all overloads of timer creation and their correct execution.

methods.name: GrainTimer_DisposeFromCallback
methods.description: Tests that timers can dispose themselves from within their callback without deadlocks or exceptions.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_Test
methods.description: Ensures that timers in non-reentrant grains respect concurrency constraints and do not overlap.

methods.name: GrainTimer_Change
methods.description: Tests changing timer periods and due times after creation, including edge cases and callback-initiated modifications.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Basic_Poco
methods.description: Tests basic timer functionality with POCO grains, verifying similar behavior as with grain-based grains.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Parallel_Poco
methods.description: Tests parallel timer execution across multiple POCO grain instances, ensuring isolation.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Migration_Poco
methods.description: Verifies that POCO grains exhibit non-persistent timer behavior across deactivation/reactivation.

methods.name: AsyncTimerTest_GrainCall_Poco
methods.description: Tests async grain calls from POCO grain timer callbacks, ensuring proper exception handling.

methods.name: GrainTimer_TestAllOverloads_Poco
methods.description: Verifies all overloads of timer creation support in POCO grains.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_Test_Poco
methods.description: Ensures POCO grains respect reentrancy constraints during timers.

methods.name: GrainTimer_Change_Poco
methods.description: Tests dynamic timer period changes and edge cases in POCO grains.
